What is the circumference of a circle with a diameter of $4\,\text{ft}?$
q-75767.worked_solution:
We use the formula $C=\pi d$ and get

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =\pi d \\  & =\pi \cdot 4 \\  & =4\pi \,\text{ft}.\end{aligned}
$$

$$

What is the circumference of a circle with a radius of $r=4?$ Round your answer to $3$ decimal places.
q-75773.worked_solution:
We use the formula $C=2\pi r$ to get

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =2\pi r \\  & =2\pi \cdot 4 \\  & =8\pi  \\  & ≈25.133,\end{aligned}
$$

rounded to three decimal places.

What is the diameter of a circle with a circumference of $12\pi \,\text{ft}?$
q-3735.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the circumference $C=\pi d$ and solve for $d.$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =\pi d \\ 12\pi  & =\pi d \\ d & =\frac{12\pi }{\pi } \\ d & =12\,\text{ft}.\end{aligned}
$$

What length of fence is needed to border a circular plot of land with a diameter of $30\,\text{m}?$
q-53553.worked_solution:
The length of the fence needed to border the circular land is its circumference.

The formula for the circumference of a circle is $C=\pi d,$ where $d=30\,\text{m}$ is the diameter.

Therefore, we have

$$
C=\pi \cdot 30=30\pi \,\text{m}.
$$

q-53553.html:
Question 8
?

What length of fence is needed to border a circular plot of land with a diameter of 30m?

a
30πm
b
15πm
c
30m
d
60πm
e
πm
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The length of the fence needed to border the circular land is its circumference.

The formula for the circumference of a circle is C=πd, where d=30m is the diameter.

Therefore, we have C=π⋅30=30πm.

What length of chain will perfectly wrap around a circular tree trunk with a diameter of $2\,\text{yd}?$
q-53554.worked_solution:
The length of the chain needed to wrap around the tree is its circumference.

The formula for the circumference of a circle is $C=\pi d,$ where $d=2\,\text{yd}$ is the diameter.

Therefore, we have

$$
C=\pi \cdot 2=2\pi \,\text{yd}.
$$
